answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed peer grading tied to a single identity. Each agent posts a small bond before grading others, and grades are checked by a random jury drawn from established, unrelated peers, so a sybil swarm cannot grade itself. Like an ember kept alive only by real work, reputation grows slowly through tasks and decays when idle or dishonest, while a mesa of public records lets anyone audit who graded whom. Creating many fake identities then costs many bonds and repeated work, but an honest agent pays once, pushing the horizon of profitable cheating far beyond its gain.
